textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event:
local rewardIds = { RewardCoins="coin", RewardDiamonds="diamond", RewardXp="xp", RewardFood="food" } local type = rewardIds[ element( "RewardId" ):GetString() ]
component("font"):Set(game.getTextFont()) component("size"):SetFloat(0.19*(lua_sys.screenWidth()/480.0)) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_RIGHT_ALIGNED) component("text"):SetString( "" .. element( "RewardAmount" ):GetString() ) component("layer"):SetString("Clipping")
if(type == "coin") then component("red"):SetFloat(1.0) component("green"):SetFloat(0.9) component("blue"):SetFloat(0.09) elseif(type == "diamond") then component("red"):SetFloat(0.27) component("green"):SetFloat(0.86) component("blue"):SetFloat(0.6) elseif(type == "food") then component("red"):SetFloat(1.0) component("green"):SetFloat(0.67) component("blue"):SetFloat(0.96) elseif(type == "xp") then component("red"):SetFloat(0.31) component("green"):SetFloat(0.94) component("blue"):SetFloat(0.26) end

spriteSheetComponent.name: Sprite
spriteSheetComponent.event:
local rewardIds = { RewardCoins="coin", RewardDiamonds="diamond", RewardXp="xp", RewardFood="food" } local type = rewardIds[ element( "RewardId" ):GetString() ]
component("spriteName"):SetString(type) component("sheetName"):SetString("xml_resources/hud01.xml")
component("size"):SetFloat(0.19*(lua_sys.screenWidth()/480.0))
component("layer"):SetString("Clipping")
